Enabled.Name: Enable Animist Apparition Manager
Enabled.Hint: When enabled, this module runs the Animist itself: apparition bonding, Vessel spells, Lore skills, the cast-rank picker and the nightly cleanup. If PF2e Dailies is installed, its own Animist daily is switched off for these characters. Turn this off before removing the module, so that Dailies gets its daily back.

Identifier.Name: Apparition Spellcasting Entry Identifier
Identifier.Hint: Identifier stored on this module's Apparition Spellcasting entry. It is used only to recognize the entry and its spells (default: animist-spontaneous).

VesselIdentifier.Name: Vessel Spells Entry Identifier
VesselIdentifier.Hint: Identifier stored on this module's Vessel Spells entry. It is used only to recognize the entry and its focus spells (default: animist-focus).

CustomApparitions.Name: Manage Custom Apparitions
CustomApparitions.Label: Manage Custom Apparitions
CustomApparitions.Hint: Create homebrew Animist apparitions with their own spell list, Lore skills, and authored Vessel spell. They become available directly in this module's apparition manager.

AutoPrimary.Name: Automatically fill primary apparitions
AutoPrimary.Hint: When enabled, bonding an apparition fills an available primary slot and unbonding a primary promotes another bonded apparition. Manual star toggles still take precedence for the current set.

WanderingRequirements.Name: Wandering Feat Requirements
WanderingRequirements.Label: Wandering Feat Requirements
WanderingRequirements.Hint: Choose which apparitions suit each wandering feat (the requirement that is only written in the feats' descriptions), and create custom wandering feats.

LoreSkillRegistry.Name: Apparition Lore Skill Registry
LoreSkillRegistry.Hint: Internal registry of apparition-granted Lore skills.

Permanent.Hint: This feat ties you to one apparition. Choose it here; it is attuned automatically after every night's rest, and it cannot be unbound until you change it.

WanderingSettings.Title: Wandering Feat Requirements
WanderingSettings.Hint: A wandering feat that asks for an attuned apparition is available only to a character bonded to one of its suitable apparitions. For the system's feats the list was worked out in advance from the Lores each feat asks for; add apparitions to a list or take them off it here. A custom wandering feat has the apparitions you mark for it; with none marked it has no requirement.
WanderingSettings.DeleteConfirm: Delete the custom wandering feat "{name}"? Characters that already have it keep their copy.
WanderingSettings.RemoveApparition: Take this apparition off the list
WanderingSettings.Reset: Back to the defaults (undo the changes to this list)
WanderingSettings.Name: Name
WanderingSettings.SuitableHint: Tick the apparitions a character must be bonded to (any one of them) to take or keep this feat.
WanderingSettings.LevelHint: Wandering feats are normally level 6, 12 or 16. A feat of another level works too: for retraining it counts as the nearest of those levels below it (level 8 counts as 6, level 18 as 16; below 6 it counts as its own level), so it is still offered.
WanderingSettings.TraitsHint: Optional extra feat tags. Animist and Wandering are always applied.
